card.name: Of and 19th-century year digits
card.fires_on: The word "of" after "issue" or "knowledge" in agriculture and natural-resource texts. Also the digit 8 or 9 inside a year such as 1830 or 1896 in American history passages.

modes.label: "of" after issue or knowledge
modes.description: The word "of" linking an issue or knowledge to an agriculture or natural-resources name.
modes.example: These teams of high school students are tested on their knowledge<< of>> natural resources – soils, forestry, wildlife

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: The third digit of a four-digit year in the 1800s or 1900s, in history about land, Indians or farms.

card.writes: It seems to suppress rural and farming words (village, farm, farmers) and promote unrelated names and words.
card.plain: It fires on the word "of" before farming or nature titles, and on the middle digit of old years in history texts.
